name: Organic Coconut Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 75–83 mg per 8 oz can
summary: USDA Organic cold brew on coconut cream from the Los Angeles roaster — the only coconut-milk can we track — sweetened with date paste rather than sugar: 5 g of total sugar with 0 g added, under 1 g of protein and 100 calories per 8 oz can, at a brand-stated 75–83 mg of caffeine.
